author: jill torkelson
text: Great service! I called in the morning for septic tank pump service. Our toilets and shower were draining slowly and backing up. The owner Randy managed to squeeze us in same day and the guys came out in a couple hours. The guys were great and very fast. They even suggested we stop using such thick toilet paper. Will definitely be using them in the future.

author: DEK 57
text: Emerald Coast did a great job draining my septic tank. They were friendly and professional, and respectful of my property. Will definitely give them my business again! Thanks!

author: Brenda Rigdon's Brens Den.
text: Really fast response to our needs. Did a good job too. 4 stars because no military or senior  discount on $400 price. I would pass the word around faster had this small discount had happened.

author: Mark Starr
text: The grinder pump failed in my septic tank.  Michael & Randy recommended that I abandon the septic tank and install a smaller, new one.  They did this and included a load of fill dirt to account for the smaller tank.  It looked great after they finished and I paid the estimated price.  I highly recommend this business.

author: Jack Smith
text: Emerald coast was ontime and did a great job pumping my tank. I've used them several times and always happy with their work!!!
